dedupe_keys.name: classification of control oriented models for wind farm control applications

description: Raach,Steffen and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed CL-Windcon work examines model calibration and sensitivity and reports blind field-validation activities. Named tools include FAST.Farm, FLORIS, WFSim and POD-based representations. The case captures how these models were used and compared in the stated wind-farm-control programme. It does not imply equal validation strength for every tool or a universally best controller. The separate scenario document records inputs and case definitions; it is not an additional completed field campaign. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
